newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee ends lower, despite GCA stock drawdown.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee ends lower, despite GCA stock drawdown.

text.p: CSCE coffee futures ended lower on Monday, pressured by producer and local selling, trading sources said.
The losses came despite a sharp drawdown in monthly consumer stocks, as traders focused on adjusting their books ahead of the spot December contract's first notice day on Tuesday.
"There was some liquidation ahead of first notice day," said Merrill Lynch analyst Judith Ganes.
"Most people had expected the stocks to come down."
Although the market received an initial boost from the stock data, traders said the drawdown was largely anticipated and already priced in the market.

The Green Coffee Association of New York reported after the close Friday that supplies of green coffee housed in U.S. warehouses fell in October by 351,000 60-kg bags, to 1,260,000 bags, their lowest level since the GCA began tracking inventories in January 1988.
Traders had called for a decline of between 200,000 and 300,000 60-kg bags in October.

On Monday, most-active March ended 1.65 cents a lb lower, at 112.65, after ranging from 115.50 to 112.00. Spot December futures fell 2.95 cent a lb on the day, to 119.55. The remaining months finished 1.00 weaker to 0.25 firmer.
The closely watched December/March spread narrowed to 6.10 cents, down from 8.20 cents at Friday's close.
Traders and analysts said low stock levels would continue to lend underlying support to the market. They awaited the weekly certified stock report due after Monday's close.
The CSCE reported last week U.S. certified coffee stocks fell to 333 60-kg bags in the week ended Nov. 8, the lowest level since the exchange started tracking inventories in 1980.
The CSCE also reported there were 1,250 bags pending grading.
But as of Friday, December's open interest stood at 3,675 lots -- the equivalent of more than 900,000 bags of coffee.
On the charts, near-term March support was pegged at the 112.00-cent level, with the next downside hurdle seen at 110.00. Resistance was put near 116.00.
The day's volume reached an estimated 8,927 lots.
